prompt:
A high-fidelity WEBSITE DESIGN COMP: a flat, screen-accurate rendering of a desktop web page at 1440px wide, viewed perfectly straight-on. No device frame, no browser chrome, no mouse cursor, no perspective tilt, no drop shadow around the page. This is a UI LAYOUT, not an illustration and not a poster: every region is a real page region with real typography at real, readable sizes and real alignment to a grid. Landscape 16:10, filling the frame edge to edge.

VISUAL WORLD — fixed, do not reinterpret, do not add to:
- Ground: rain-black, #07090D to #0D1420. Wet, deep, matte.
- Primary accent: one scarlet, #E6202C. This is the only accent on interface elements: the primary button, key rules, active ticks.
- Signage-only colours: magenta #FF2F7F and cyan #26D4EC. These appear ONLY inside the photographic city imagery as lit signs and reflections. They NEVER touch interface text, buttons, tables, or labels.
- Text: off-white #E8E6E1 for primary, concrete grey #7A8089 for secondary.
- Display type: very condensed, heavy, uppercase industrial signage lettering, tight tracking, slightly screen-printed / grainy edges.
- Label and body type: a technical monospace, small, uppercase for labels, wide letter-spacing.
- Materials: wet asphalt reflections, dense stacked vertical signage, hazard chevron stripes in off-white and black, riveted metal plates, hairline rules.

THE CRITICAL RULE OF THIS DESIGN: the neon and the glow live ONLY in the photographic imagery. Every region that carries data, specs, tables, or running text is a CALM, matte, near-black plate with crisp off-white type and at most a scarlet hairline or tick. There is no glow, no bloom, and no gradient haze behind any text. A spec table in this design is quiet and perfectly legible.
PAGE STRUCTURE, top to bottom — build the layout in exactly this order and these proportions:

1. THIN TOP BAR, about 4% of the height, spanning the full width. Rain-black. Far left: a small scarlet geometric mark plus the wordmark SHADOWORD in condensed uppercase, letter-spaced. Far right, small mono uppercase: LINUX FIRST, OFFLINE BY DEFAULT, and a scarlet outlined button reading READ THE SOURCE.

2. HERO, about 70% of the height, SPLIT VERTICALLY INTO TWO UNEQUAL ZONES by one hard, perfectly straight vertical scarlet line running the full height of the hero. This boundary line is the most important element on the page.
   LEFT ZONE, 55% of the width: full-bleed photographic night-city imagery. A dense rain-black street wall of stacked lit vertical signage in magenta and cyan, glyph panels, cables, wet reflections pooling at the bottom, red taillight streaks. It is bright, busy, saturated and loud. Every lit element in it stops dead at the scarlet boundary line — nothing crosses, no glow spills past it, the light does not bleed over the line.
   RIGHT ZONE, 45% of the width: a completely CALM matte near-black console plate. No imagery, no glow, no gradient. Riveted at its corners, with a hairline grid. It carries, stacked with generous spacing:
   - a small scarlet mono label reading LOCAL MODE
   - the headline in large condensed heavy uppercase off-white, three lines, left-aligned: SPEECH TO TEXT / THAT NEVER LEAVES / YOUR MACHINE
   - one line of grey mono: LINUX FIRST. LOCAL WHISPER BY DEFAULT. YOU CHOOSE THE MODEL AND THE SILICON.
   - a horizontal three-position selector divided by hairlines with mono uppercase labels OFF, LOCAL, REMOTE, where LOCAL is marked selected by a small lit scarlet square and a scarlet underline
   - a solid scarlet rectangular button with off-white mono uppercase reading READ THE SOURCE, and beneath it small grey mono reading GITHUB.COM/FRACTAL-TESS/SHADOWORD
   - at the bottom of the plate, a hairline-divided row in small mono: PUSH TO TALK on the left, and a scarlet key glyph reading F2 on the right
   Along the very top edge of the right zone, a narrow strip of hazard chevron stripes in off-white and black.

3. BOUNDARY CAPTION STRIP, about 5% of the height, full width, calm matte near-black, a scarlet hairline above. Left-aligned mono uppercase, letter-spaced, small: AUDIO REACHES THE MODEL OVER A FUNCTION CALL, NEVER A SOCKET. At the far right of this strip, in grey mono: NO SOCKET IS OPENED.

4. SECOND FOLD BEGINS, the bottom 21%, cropped by the frame edge. Calm matte near-black, NO imagery. A four-column model catalog table with hairline rules and a scarlet mono column header row reading MODEL, SIZE, NOTE. Rows in off-white mono: LARGE V3 TURBO with 1.62 GIB and DEFAULT. MULTILINGUAL.; LARGE V3 with 2.88 GIB; MEDIUM ENGLISH with 1.42 GIB; SMALL ENGLISH with 466 MIB. The first row is marked with a small scarlet tick. This table is perfectly quiet and legible, the visual opposite of the left zone above it.

TEXT: render every word listed above exactly and spelled correctly. Do not invent any other words, numbers, benchmarks, latencies, prices, star counts, or testimonials anywhere in the image. Any lettering inside the photographic city signage is decorative and must not read as English claims.

DO NOT: add a browser window, tab bar, URL bar, or window controls. Do not tilt or angle the page. Do not let the left zone's glow, bloom, or coloured light cross or bleed over the scarlet boundary line. Do not let magenta or cyan appear anywhere in the right zone or in the two bottom regions.
